title: ADC Testbench
text: Measures DC and AC performance metrics of ADC output, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Analog stimulus frequency (Hz)} sets Frequency of the analog input signal to ADC positive real scalar; {Measurement} selects whether to measure DC or AC performance metrics, {Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result, {Set as model stop time} sets the automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time, {Endpoint} sets the measure DNL, INL using endpoint method, {Best fit} sets the measure DNL, INL using best fit method, {Plot DC analysis result}, {Export measurement result} sets the store detailed test results to base workspace, {Sample interval (s)} sets the rate at which ADC Testbench polls input, {Distortion measurement type} sets the type of distortion, {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the resolution bandwidth positive, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of the start conversion clock of the ADC, {RMS aperture jitter (s)} sets the rMS aperture jitter to be added by the start conversion clock, {Error tolerance (LSB)} sets the maximum difference between successive samples of analog, {Automatically determine sweep range}, {Sweep range} sets the custom sweep range, {Stop simulation on completion}, {Autofill setup parameter} sets the automatically propagate setup parameters from ADC, {Number of bits} sets the number of physical output bits, {Input range (V)} sets the aDC dynamic range, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delay before measurement analysis, {Show spectrum analyzer during simulation} sets the displays spectrum analyzer during, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Autofill target metric} sets the automatically propagate target metrics from ADC, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value and {Gain error} sets the error on the slope of ADC transfer curve. Values come from the instance.
